svg.title: Polar curves: cardioid, limacon, rose, lemniscate; red orientation sketches and blue equations with odd/even notes, and corrective arrows connecting rose/lemniscate formulas.

g.text: r = a(1 ± cos θ) or a(1 ± sin θ), a > 0
r = a ± b cos θ or a ± b sin θ, a,b > 0
r = a cos(nθ) or a sin(nθ), a ≠ 0
r² = a² cos(2θ) or a² sin(2θ), a ≠ 0

svg.text: Rose: odd n → n petals; even n → 2n petals.
